title: Identity address format
risk: Broken derivation would prevent peers from addressing this node.

title: Hello endpoint never exposes private keys
risk: Private key leakage would compromise the identity.

title: Valid signed envelope is accepted
risk: Delivery is core functionality.

title: Tampered ciphertext is rejected
risk: A forged message could impersonate the sender.

title: Sender nodeId spoofing is rejected
risk: Spoofed identity would bypass signature binding.

title: Replay of the same envelope is ignored
risk: Replay would duplicate messages.

title: Relayed message is delivered to the final recipient
risk: Store-and-forward is broken: the relay changes signed fields (ttl/hops) and re-signs with its own key.

title: Inbound delivery is rate limited
risk: No per-IP limits: a LAN attacker can flood the inbox and fill the store.

title: Oversized envelopes are rejected without killing the node
risk: Body cap exists (4 MB) but the connection is destroyed without a clean 413.

title: Published site is served through the gateway
risk: Core hosting path.

title: Served HTML is sandboxed against the gateway origin
evidence: CSP: sandbox allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-modals; default-src 'self' data: blob:; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline';
risk: A malicious site can call /web/announce and read other sites because every .neuro site shares the gateway origin.

title: Blobs are scoped to their manifest (no unauthenticated enumeration)
risk: Any blob in the store can be fetched by hash, leaking content across sites.

title: Manifest nodeId must match the signing key
risk: nodeId is unchecked; an attacker can impersonate another node id in manifests.

title: Domain claims require possession of the content
risk: Anyone can claim any .neuro domain with fake hashes and no data, blocking the real owner.

title: Announce only stores blobs referenced by the manifest
risk: Junk blobs can fill the 256 MB store without a site referencing them.

title: Cross-origin announce is blocked
risk: Any web page can POST to the local gateway and inject manifests (same-as-local API).

title: Gateway blocks encoded path traversal
risk: Encoded traversal could expose gateway APIs or other files.

title: Folder publishing does not follow symlinks/junctions
risk: A junction inside a site folder can publish arbitrary local files (secrets, SSH keys).

title: Unpublish garbage-collects its blobs
risk: Content is never deleted; storage grows forever.

title: Remote resolve does not claim domains locally
risk: Resolving a hostile .neuro site silently stores and claims it on the victim node.

title: Invalid domains are rejected
risk: Domain validation bypass.

title: A claimed domain cannot be taken by another key
risk: Domain hijacking.

title: neuro:// asset protocol cannot escape the resources folder
risk: Encoded path traversal in the custom protocol can read application files.

title: Plugin vm cannot reach the host process
risk: A malicious plugin can escape the vm context and run arbitrary code in the main process.
